text:
julia: Heads-up: Glacier Finance wants a short presales pack — EU+CA residency, explicit no-US-data-plane, subproc list, and egress delta for quoting. Need a quick checklist.
noah: Are they okay with hosted pinned regions or need dedicated from day one?
julia: Prefer hosted pinned to move fast, but will select dedicated if price delta is small. BYOK required.
priya: Legal reminder: control-plane orchestration metadata may transit via us-east unless they pick Private. Data plane can be pinned to europe-west1, europe-west2 (UK), and ca-central1.
devin: Subproc touching data plane in those regions: GCP (compute + storage), Fastly (edge), HashiCorp Vault (optional BYOK). Sentry only for errors (no PII).
julia: Egress delta — what multipliers should I quote for CA vs hosted default?
devin: Ballpark: ca-central1 +0.19, eu-west1 +0.11, europe-west2 +0.10. Mark as estimate in SOW.
noah: SOW snippet to paste into questionnaire:
```
residency_policy:
  regions: [europe-west1, europe-west2, ca-central1]
  data_plane: pinned
  control_plane: hosted(us-east1) # Private available on request
  kms: BYOK_supported
  egress_multiplier: { ca-central1: 1.19, europe-west1: 1.11, europe-west2: 1.10 }
```
infra-bot: Provisioning event: pinned-dataplane (ca-central1, europe-west1) template validated :white_check_mark: job=11022
priya: Security Q guidance: "Do you transfer data outside customer region?" Reply: "Data plane is pinned to customer-selected regions. Control-plane orchestration metadata may traverse other regions; Private deployment option avoids cross-region control-plane flows. See attached attestation and SCC annex."
julia: Can infra provide a CSV with subproc name, country, transfer_direction, cert URL? Need for security questionnaire.
devin: I'll drop the CSV + attestation links into the shared drive by EOD. Also note: Fastly can be configured with no-logs edge policy.
julia: One more ask — customer wants a 48h 1% EU+CA canary to measure latency before full cutover. Any ops concerns?
devin: Canary ok on hosted pinned. Recommend dedicated/reserved for sustained SLOs under burst. No infra blockers for a short canary.
julia: Thanks — I'll compile answers into the SOW and send to Glacier. :thumbsup:
